WITH account_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount 
             WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount 
         END) AS avg_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM trans t
  INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
region_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(avg_amount) AS region_avg_amount,
    AVG(avg_balance) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM account_averages
  GROUP BY region
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) AS global_avg_amount
  FROM region_averages
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.region_avg_amount,
  r.region_avg_balance,
  r.region_avg_amount / g.global_avg_amount AS ratio
FROM region_averages r
CROSS JOIN global_mean g
WHERE g.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
